The energy tokens you are holding onto do not count towards your score. Only the tokens dropped or already present in your starting cell count towards your score.

    - "TAKE" to take the energy token
    - "DROP" to drop the energy token

    - You must not use more than 20 actions (includes movement, take and drop).
